class.name: StreamingAssetsPackBuilder
class.brief_description: Builds the streaming assets folder into the streaming pack.

method.name: build
method.description: Builds the files of [param source_folder] (see [method make_description]) into a pack at [param target_path], with the export pipeline of [param preset] and without the dependencies outside the folder. [param debug] exports like a debug export. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a null preset, an empty target path or a [param source_folder] that is not a folder below [code]res://[/code]. See [method PCKPackageExporter.export_description_with_preset] for the other errors.

method.name: get_pack_path
method.description: Returns the path of the streaming pack for an export to [param export_path]: [param pack_file] in the folder of [param export_path]. This is the folder of the main pack, also for an executable with an embedded pack. Returns an empty string if [param export_path] is empty or [param pack_file] is not a plain file name (it contains a folder, for example). [codeblock] StreamingAssetsPackBuilder.get_pack_path("C:/Builds/Game.exe", "Game.streaming.pck") # "C:/Builds/Game.streaming.pck" [/codeblock]

method.name: make_description
method.description: Returns a [PCKPackage] description with one entry per file below [param source_folder], whose target is the [code]res://[/code] path of the file without [code]res://[/code]. The files are those of [method StreamingAssetsExportPlugin.collect_files], without files imported as "Skip File" ([code]importer="skip"[/code] in their [code].import[/code] file), which the export never writes. Returns [code]null[/code] if [param source_folder] is not a folder below [code]res://[/code].
